title: Specification of a gate gadget
statement: Let $n,c,	ext{cost}$ be natural numbers, let $P$ be a property of gates, let $g$ be a gate, let $gs$ be a list of gates, and let $r=(r_1,r_2)$ be a list of gates together with a natural-number vertex. A gadget specification requires that $r_1$ extend $gs$ by appending some list; that $r_1$ be acyclic on $n$ inputs; that $r_2<n+|r_1|$; and that, on every Boolean input, the value at $r_2$ in $r_1$ equal the evaluation of $g$ on the values obtained by running $gs$ on that input. It also requires $|r_1||gs|+	ext{cost}$, depth at $r_2$ at most $c$ plus the maximum depth in $gs$ of the arguments of $g$ (with empty maximum taken as $0$), and that every gate appended to $gs$ satisfy $P$.
hypotheses_covered: $r_1$ is $gs$ followed by an extension list
for every input, the specified vertex value equals evaluation of $g$ on the outputs of $gs$
depth bound by $c$ plus maximum argument depth, with empty maximum $0$
